"""Start the qualified frozen V53 collector after verified V52 archival."""

from datetime import datetime
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess


MAIN = Path("/home/longhao/experiment/BeliefKV")
ROOT = Path("/home/longhao/experiment/.worktrees/beliefkv-v25-followup-20261011")
TARGET = Path("/home/longhao/experiment/.worktrees/beliefkv-v299-v53-empty-restore-20261013")
PYTHON = "/home/longhao/miniconda3/envs/beliefkv-next/bin/python"
STATE = MAIN / "experiments/reports/v53_launch_after_v52_20261013.json"
LOG = STATE.with_suffix(".log")
REGISTRATION = ROOT / "experiments/reports/v302_v53_launch_registration_20261013.json"
ARCHIVE = ROOT / "experiments/reports/v301_v52_workspace_archive_20261013.json"
if STATE.exists() or LOG.exists() or REGISTRATION.exists():
    raise ValueError("preserve existing launch")
archive = json.loads(ARCHIVE.read_bytes())
if (
    archive["status"] != "verified_and_cleaned"
    or archive["source_workspace_count_after_cleanup"] != 0
    or archive["comparison"]["exit_code"] != 0
):
    raise ValueError("V52 archive has not been verified and cleaned")
revision = subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=TARGET, text=True).strip()
qualified = subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "02c171a"], cwd=ROOT, text=True).strip()
if revision != qualified:
    raise ValueError("target differs from qualified candidate")
qualification = ROOT / "experiments/reports/v299_empty_restore_qualification_20261013.json"
for name, digest in json.loads(qualification.read_bytes())["source_sha256"].items():
    if hashlib.sha256((TARGET / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() != digest:
        raise ValueError(f"frozen source changed: {name}")
args = [
    PYTHON, str(TARGET / "scripts/launch_semantic_h2d_after_pair.py"),
    "--repo", str(MAIN),
    "--previous-run", str(MAIN / "experiments/raw/qwen35_native_predictive_replenished_108plus48_20261013_v52"),
    "--previous-checkout", "/home/longhao/experiment/.worktrees/beliefkv-v292-v52-post-launch-20261013",
    "--target-checkout", str(TARGET),
    "--run-root", str(MAIN / "experiments/raw/qwen35_native_predictive_replenished_108plus48_20261013_v53"),
    "--state", str(STATE),
    "--development-restart", "--port", "18458",
    "--arm-order", "predictive_h2d", "--execution-handoff", "0",
]
for pid in (539440, 539690, 540060, 541551):
    args += ["--wait-pid", str(pid)]
with LOG.open("xb") as stream:
    process = subprocess.Popen(
        args, cwd=TARGET, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=stream,
        stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True,
    )
row = {
    "registered_at_local": datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),
    "coordinator_pid": process.pid, "args": args, "target_revision": revision,
    "log": str(LOG), "state": str(STATE),
    "qualification_sha256": hashlib.sha256(qualification.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    "archive_receipt_sha256": hashlib.sha256(ARCHIVE.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    "helper_sha256": hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    "helper_utf8_source": Path(__file__).read_text(),
    "scope": "Launch registration; real execution and deployment still require validation.",
}
REGISTRATION.write_text(json.dumps(row, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
print(json.dumps({key: row[key] for key in ("registered_at_local", "coordinator_pid", "target_revision")}, indent=2))
